thread:
Rina (PM): Quick design question: should burst be a toggle + numeric or a single slider that snaps to integers? mock: https://internal.redwood.design/mockups/autoscale-burst-mini.png

Omar (Design): Prefer slider with snap + inline number. Cleaner and communicates range. Slider needs visible ticks at common values.

Tess (Eng): Backend uses integer `burst_units` 0..6. Slider snapping ok. We'll return `unit_price` so UI can show cost.

Cara (Designer): Layout: min/max steppers on the left, slider on the right. Add a tiny help link: 'How burst works'.

Liam (A11y): Ensure slider keyboard support and aria-valuetext like 'Burst units: 2 (adds 2 GPUs)'. Error states should announce via aria-live.

Rina (PM): Microcopy idea for guardrail: 'Max for selected pool is X GPUs. Increase pool capacity or lower your minimum.' Thoughts?

Omar (Design): Shorten: 'Selected pool supports up to X GPUs. Lower minimum or choose a larger pool.'

Tess (Eng): We'll add an 'auto-fix' button: 'Set max to X'. API will accept patch.

deploy-bot: Mock uploaded: s3://redwood-mockups/autoscale-burst-mini.png

Rina (PM): Great. Next: Omar to update mock, Liam quick a11y pass, Tess to wire cost calc. Sync Friday if any blockers.
